## linux.partition

**Recorded native contract:** mount_point selects partitions. The native mount_options_complete rule already requires effective options; configuration-file evidence alone is insufficient. Space fields and block_size are integers.

[Tracking issue](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/issues/3); native adoption and runtime qualification remain pending.

**Legacy observations, not normative:** OVAL calls space quantities physical block counts and block_size bytes per block; options require complete runtime evidence, not only configuration or one mount-table source.

Native sources: [linux.partition.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/linux.partition.json#/native), [linux.partition.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/linux.partition.json#/semantic_validator_rules).

**Converted-content comparison:** 135 historical Test occurrences; 1 pinned specimens with original signed-source dependencies. These are historical grammar, not current validation or scanner proof. [Content evidence](../metadata/developer-guide-content-audit.json).

### partition-units

**Gap:** Native integer space fields do not declare units; mount namespaces, duplicate mount identities and option cardinality need acquisition guidance.

**Recommendation:** Preserve the existing effective-option requirement. Recommend one field value per effective option and target mount identity/namespace evidence. Recommend legacy-compatible block counts with explicit byte block_size, without assuming one block-size source. Missing mount differs from unreadable/incomplete mount evidence.

**Compatibility:** Interpreting historical block counts as bytes changes comparisons. Bind/overlay mounts and reserved free blocks need independent fixtures; do not collapse duplicate mount-point observations.

## linux.rpminfo

**Recorded native contract:** Mapping alternatives and migration metadata author package_name; selector_map records the source name to native package_name crosswalk. No dedicated resolved Object overlay exists. include_file_paths is an explicit required mapping parameter. full_path comparisons require requested paths or equivalent complete reused evidence.

[Tracking issue](https://github.com/vanderpol/scap-ng/issues/3); native adoption and runtime qualification remain pending.

**Legacy observations, not normative:** OVAL provides package identity, architecture, raw epoch, EVR, signature-key identifier and optional package-owned paths. Missing raw epoch may be (none), while composed EVR uses zero.

Native sources: [linux.rpminfo.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/linux.rpminfo.json#/native), [linux.rpminfo.json](../../schema/capability-mappings/supported/linux.rpminfo.json#/semantic_validator_rules).

### rpm-identity

**Gap:** The guide labels selector_map source keys as authored fields; the generic schema accepts both source name and native package_name. Installed version/architecture populations, epoch normalization and path completeness need acquisition guidance.

**Recommendation:** Follow the mapping native alternative package_name for the research example, and record generic schema acceptance separately. Recommend retaining every installed version/architecture identity, raw epoch and explicit EVR comparison semantics. Report key ID as identification evidence, not signature verification. Do not return a complete path population when include_file_paths was false unless independently complete reused evidence exists.

**Compatibility:** Both source name and package_name pass the current generic Object baseline; this is not alias approval. Do not silently rename authored fields or change raw (none) epoch to integer zero. Package database denial is not proof of absence.
